output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initial totalSupply is set to 0, and anyone can exploit this vulnerability by repeatedly calling mintToken to increase the balanceOf the attacker without transferring ether, causing a denial of service to the owner.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balanceOf[_to] += _value overflows, it gets stuck in the to address forever.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balanceOf[_to] += _value overflows, it gets stuck in the to address forever.
